purpose: Detect stale ConfigData Lookup artifacts through dependency-aware hashes, rebuild only affected bounded layers, and write only artifacts whose deterministic content changed.

stalePolicy.stage1: Compare each current raw source SHA-256 with the source hash embedded in its Stage 1 entity index; rebuild only dirty entities.
stalePolicy.stage2: Compare current raw source SHA-256 values with source hashes embedded in each Stage 2 domain index; parse only source types required by dirty domains.
stalePolicy.stage3: Compare current Stage 2 forward artifact hashes and predecessor hashes with the Stage 3 manifest; rebuild from materialized Stage 2 edges and write only target files whose deterministic bytes changed.
stalePolicy.stage4: Compare frozen canonical input hashes and Stage 3 predecessor hashes with the Stage 4 manifest; rebuild from admitted frozen projections and write only domain files whose deterministic bytes changed.
stalePolicy.stage5: Recompute only the Stage 5 summary from the Stage 5 contract and Stage 4 predecessor summary; no raw ConfigData read is allowed.
stalePolicy.contractHashBaseline: The Stage 6 dependency manifest records Stage 1-6 contract hashes. A changed owning contract dirties that owning materialization layer; downstream layers advance only when their actual inputs change.

requiredChecks: Stage 1 stale detection is source-hash based per entity
Stage 2 stale detection is source-hash based per domain
Stage 2 rebuild loads only source types required by dirty domains
Stage 3 stale detection uses Stage 2 artifact hashes rather than raw ConfigData scans
Stage 4 stale detection uses frozen canonical input hashes and predecessor hashes
Stage 5 refresh remains summary-only and does not read raw ConfigData
incremental rebuild writes only byte-changed artifacts
dependency manifest and summary are byte-identical after regeneration
no wall-clock timestamp enters generated artifacts
package scripts expose check, rebuild, and validation commands

nextStage.goal: Expose the dependency manifest to Project Doctor / Smart Regression so changed ConfigData inputs can select only the downstream validators and page pipelines that are actually affected.
